note: The one place for the site's own address and the chain it reads. The browser reads it through web/js/config.js; scripts/gen_feed.py and scripts/gen_site_recorded.py read it too, and scripts/apply_site_config.py writes site_url into the static files (index.html meta tags, sitemap.xml, agent-quickstart.txt, README). Switching to mainnet: change network, contract, rpc_urls, explorer_tx, explorer_account and tx_index here. checkers lists the two checker image ids on the contract's allowlist: crash (published_image_id, the same) and output (wrong answers, also memory safety bugs). new_badge_until_utc ends the "New" sticker on wrong output and memory safety bounties: the ship date (2026-11-08) plus 30 days, a UTC date; the site hides the sticker from that day on, with no redeploy.
